lines.text: To: Valdorso Coatings, attn. Dr. E. Marchisio
Re: your complaint of 20/11/95 on CL-77 lots 95-09 and
We confirm that a washing stage of the CL-77 process was
shortened in September 1995, which raised the free alkali.
The process has been corrected. All lots from 96-02 onwards
are released with free alkalinity of 0.25 % or less; the
certificate is attached to each delivery.
We apologise for the inconvenience caused.
